sources.snippet: RWKV (pronounced RwaKuv) is an RNN with great LLM performance, which can also be directly trained like a GPT transformer (parallelizable). We are at RWKV-7 "Goose". So it's combining the best of RNN and transformer - great performance, linear time, constant space (no kv-cache), fast training, infinite ctx_len, and free sentence embedding. - BlinkDL/RWKV-LM

sources.title: rwkv7-g1: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview rwkv7-g1 is a base reasoning model built on pure RNN architecture by BlinkDL, designed for post-training and fine-tuning rather than direct use. The model uses RWKV's linear complexity approach instead of traditional transformer attention, enabling constant-speed inference regardless of sequence length and consistently low memory consumption.
